applicableAreas: Buildings 1-8 on site adjacent to overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Site plan shows overhead electric lines (OHE) on west and south property boundaries adjacent to proposed buildings. No surveyed elevations of overhead conductors provided. No clearance dimension annotations showing 7.5-foot minimum horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from conductors to building faces. Building elevation sheets with conductor elevation data are not included in the site plan set.

applicableAreas: All proposed buildings and facilities adjacent to overhead electric lines on site boundaries
findings.comment: Voltage classification of existing overhead electric lines (distribution <60kV or transmission ≥60kV) is not specified on site plan or utility plans. No radial clearance dimension annotations provided showing minimum 15-foot clearance from distribution primary and neutral conductors. Clearance compliance cannot be verified without voltage identification and dimensional evidence.

applicableAreas: Buildings adjacent to Valley View Road right-of-way where overhead electric facilities exist
findings.comment: Overhead utility poles and service lines exist in Valley View Road ROW and adjacent to property. No clearance dimension annotations provided demonstrating that buildings maintain minimum 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances from overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors.

Building elevation sheets showing surveyed overhead conductor elevations and locations are not provided in the site plan set. Clearance compliance cannot be demonstrated without elevation views and conductor survey data.

applicableAreas: All buildings and structures adjacent to overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Section and plan view exhibits with dimension lines measuring from outer electric conductor to building edges are not provided. Site plan shows OHE lines as single dashed lines without dimensional verification of clearances from conductors to buildings, parking areas, or other structures.

Driveway grades shown on grading plan adjacent to overhead electric lines on site. No vertical clearance dimension annotations provided showing minimum 16-foot (parking without truck traffic) or 18-foot (areas with truck traffic) clearance from lowest point of overhead electric facilities. Overhead conductor elevations not surveyed or documented.

applicableAreas: All overhead electric line annotations on site plan
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines are depicted on site plan as single dashed lines labeled OHE without specification of outside conductor location. No dimension lines originate from identified outside conductor positions. Proper measurement from outside conductor (not pole centerline) is not demonstrated on any clearance annotations.

applicableAreas: Buildings 1-8 on west side of property near overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Proposed building structures are positioned adjacent to existing overhead distribution electric lines on west property boundary. No easement exhibit or clearance verification provided demonstrating that buildings do not violate the prohibition against installing customer facilities under or over Austin Energy overhead distribution facilities. Absolute clearance verification from outside conductor required.

applicableAreas: Driveway and parking areas adjacent to overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Proposed site features (driveways, parking areas) are located adjacent to overhead electric lines where vertical clearances appear potentially marginal. No registered surveyor field data provided showing pole locations and mid-span clearance measurements to verify minimum 16-18 foot vertical clearance requirements are met.

applicableAreas: South boundary of property where landscape trees are proposed directly adjacent to overhead electric line
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows multiple tree symbols plotted directly over and adjacent to the OHE line on the south property boundary. No distance dimensions provided showing lateral clearances from tree trunks to overhead conductors. No verification that planted tree species are designated as Utility Compatible (UC) per ECM Appendix F descriptive categories. Compliance with 10-foot distribution conductor or 50-foot transmission conductor clearance requirements cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Cover sheet and general notes for entire project
findings.comment: Site plans show overhead electric distribution lines on property boundaries. Sheet 3 (General Notes) includes 48-hour pre-construction meeting requirement for transmission lines only. No general plan note or cover sheet note is provided requiring property owner/contractor notification to Austin Energy at least 48 hours before construction work commencing near distribution overhead electric lines per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003.
